commit_message:
Allow more than eight traces/columns by removing the previous 8-item guard and truncation logic. Changes:
- GroupSideMenu.tsx: removed reading of `data` from CSV store and the unique-values check that prompted the user to bin a grouping column when >8 unique values.
- AxisSideMenuStore.ts: removed the hard cap that prevented adding a y-axis column when there were already 8 columns.
- PlotlyHelpers.ts: removed the warning and slice that truncated generated traces to 8.
This lifts the former 8-trace restriction across the UI and plot generation; be aware of potential performance impacts when plotting many traces.
